defaultGrantCount.label: Default /siphon give Count
defaultGrantCount.description: Number of empty Orbs of Siphoning granted by '/siphon give' when no explicit count is provided.

allowCrossSlotReplacement.label: Allow Cross-Slot Replacement When Capacity Permits
allowCrossSlotReplacement.description: When true, a stored Prefix may replace a Suffix (or vice versa) if the target item still stays within its Prefix/Suffix caps.

preserveExactRolledValues.label: Preserve Exact Rolled Values
preserveExactRolledValues.description: Keep the exact integer stat values stolen from the source item when imbuing the target item.
